report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Arjun Mehta | Age: 59
Body Temperature at Scene: 18.6°C | Ambient Temperature: 24.7°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 15.3 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  2. Neck: Compression marks consistent with ligature strangulation [SEVERE]
  3. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  4. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
